answer: The walnut register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and hollow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 15 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
